versions.name: Babbitt Cub World at Zink Scout Ranch

features.note: A fishing pond with a replica paddle boat moored in it.
The Bertlesmeyer Indian Kiva runs a nature program on Native American relationships with the environment.
Packs cook at their own campsites, which have large grills.
Shooting sports areas are reserved with the campmaster at check-in.
Themed program areas include a replica medieval castle, a western frontier fort, a riverboat, and a ghost ship.

versions.summary: Family and Cub Scout program area at Zink Scout Ranch near Skiatook, Oklahoma, operated by the Indian Nations Council.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
